# Featured home imagery

The local WebP files in this directory are resized derivatives of the following Wikimedia Commons photographs. They are used only for the matching place cards on the inspace homepage.

| Local file | Place | Author | Original | License |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `bund.webp` | 外滩 | GillyBerlin | [The Bund in Shanghai](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:The_Bund_in_Shanghai.jpg) | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) |
| `forbidden-city.webp` | 故宫 | Jacob Ehnmark | [Forbidden city 06](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Forbidden_city_06.jpg) | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) |
| `potala.webp` | 布达拉宫 | cattan2011 | [Potala Palace - Lhasa, Tibet](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Potala_Palace_-_Lhasa,_Tibet.jpg) | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) |
| `west-lake.webp` | 西湖 | Jacob Ehnmark | [China Hangzhou Westlake-2](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:China_Hangzhou_Westlake-2.jpg) | [CC BY 2.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/2.0/) |
| `bayi-square.webp` | 八一广场 | 钉钉 | [Bayi Square, Nanchang](https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Bayi_Square,_Nanchang.jpg) | [CC BY-SA 4.0](https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by-sa/4.0/) |

The homepage exposes the same credits and license links through the “精选地点图片来源与许可” disclosure below the featured shelf.
